summary.text: Derrick Lente is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 65 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner with a law degree from the University of New Mexico.

paragraphs.text: Lente graduated from Bernalillo High School, earned a B.A. in intercultural communications and English from the University of New Mexico, and received his J.D. from the University of New Mexico School of Law.
His professional experience includes working as a small businessman and as a professor and visiting professor at several universities across the country.
